issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath R4 §6.5 Boolean Logic + Singleton Evaluation of Collections
issues.evidence: All boolean logic surfaces treat toBoolean-convertible singletons as truthy true instead of applying toBoolean conversion. Repro (all three engines: core Python engine, DuckDB native C++, DuckDB Python fallback): 0 and true -> true (spec: false); 0 xor false -> true (spec: false); 'false' implies false -> false (spec: true); t implies 'false' -> true (spec: false); 'false'.not() -> false (spec: true); 0.not() -> false (spec: true). Root causes: fhir4ds/fhirpath/engine/invocations/logic.py::_singleton_boolean; fhir4ds/fhirpath/engine/invocations/existence.py::not_fn (via misc.boolean_singleton); fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/operators.py::_get_boolean_value + boolean_not; extensions/fhirpath/src/fhirpath/evaluator.cpp::collectionIsBool (lines 8491-8493). Correct semantics: try toBoolean conversion first (bool; 1/0, 1.0/0.0; strings true/t/yes/y/1, false/f/no/n/0 case-insensitive); only a non-convertible single node evaluates to true. Non-convertible truthy behavior already correct and must be preserved. Native/fallback parity holds (both identically wrong) so parity tests missed it.
issues.root_cause: QA misread of the Singleton Evaluation of Collections first branch. The official R4 test suite (testIntegerBooleanNotTrue: `(0).not() = false` -> true; testIntegerBooleanNotFalse: `(1).not() = false` -> true) mandates that non-boolean singletons, including toBoolean-convertible ones (0, 'false'), are TRUTHY in boolean-logic operand evaluation. toBoolean conversion criteria do NOT apply to and/or/xor/implies/not() operands. Original code was correct.
issues.resolution: Behavioral change REVERTED per the Recovery Gate after the official fixture testIntegerBooleanNotTrue failed (934/935). Reverted: evaluator.cpp singletonBooleanCoerce + fn_not change, core logic.py/_singleton_boolean + existence.not_fn, duckdb operators.py/_get_boolean_value, bundled + site-packages extension binaries. Added permanent regression tests asserting truthy semantics anchored to the official fixtures (test_conformance_regressions.py, test_boolean_logic_parity.py dual-path). Conformance restored 2832/2832.
